headline: STL @ CIN matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is STL 5.76 at CIN 4.42, with a projected total of 10.17. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward STL: STL moved +0.92 runs while CIN moved +0.03, changing the projected margin by +0.88 runs. The projected total climbed +0.95, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability dropped -12.6%, so the first-inning read became more YRFI/early-scoring friendly. Pitching context: Matthew Liberatore has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 3.2 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Alec Burleson, Spencer Steer, Iván Herrera, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Will Benson because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
